capabilities: Connect to a Unabyss account via OAuth 2.0 + PKCE
Push changed notes to Unabyss using a hash-based delta sync
Pull Unabyss exports into a vault folder as Markdown files
Configure folder scopes, direction toggles, and deletion handling
Force a full resync that rebuilds the local hash cache
extras: The README warns that OAuth tokens are stored as plaintext in data.json and can leak through other sync layers covering .obsidian/; OS-keychain support is on the roadmap. Self-hosted backends are supported via a configurable API base URL.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync notes with an external Unabyss memory service or bring its exports back into the vault.
summary: Two-way sync plugin that pushes vault notes to the Unabyss service as incremental deltas and pulls Unabyss exports back as Markdown files.
